This role requires strong leadership, hands-on problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced, operational environment.

· Manage payments to terminal service providers.

· Coordinate bays, platforms, and scheduled arrivals and departures.

· Coordinate terminal staff (assistants, supervisors, support staff), including payroll, schedules, and incident tracking.

· Oversee general terminal administration: supplies, access control, maintenance, safety and security, cleaning, and local vendors.

· Manage auxiliary services, cleaning, and bus maintenance coordination.

· Oversee inventory management.

· Generate weekly and monthly reports on incidents, billing (payment status, pending items, discrepancies), operations, and inventory.

· Build tracking dashboards to support decision-making.

· Provide insights on recurring incidents by business partner, route, unit, or technology.

· Proven experience in staff leadership and people management.

· Experience implementing and monitoring training programs and safety procedures.

· Strong ability to work with external and internal stakeholders.

· Experience in budget management and financial reporting.

· Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

· Excellent communication skills.

· Personal initiative, resilience, and a self-driven, goal-oriented working attitude.

· Ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced, operational environment.

· Fluency in English is required.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

· Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.

· Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.

· Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.

· Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.

· Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.

· Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Vos missions
Chez Doctolib, l’équipe CC (Customer Care) & Sales Operations est responsable d’améliorer l’efficacité et l’impact de nos équipes Sales, Account Managers et Support, tout en entretenant un haut niveau de motivation, d’engagement et de passion. Nous sommes une équipe de 25 personnes très motivées, en charge de l’organisation, de la stratégie, de la data, des processus, des outils et du coaching de nos 600+ Sales, Consultant·e·s et Account Managers.
L’équipe CC & Sales Ops est rattachée au Sales Ops Director, lui-même sous la direction de la VP Growth France.
Au sein de cette équipe, l’équipe Analytics & Strategy (4 membres à temps plein et 2 stagiaires) pilote tous les sujets liés à l’analyse et l’exploration de données, au suivi, à la modélisation et au forecasting de la performance pour générer des insights actionnables, améliorer les processus et suivre de près la performance versus notre budget prévisionnel.
En tant que Senior Customer Operations Analyst, vous serez le/la référent·e analytique de nos opérations, avec un focus spécifique sur nos équipes Support, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec Product Marketing, Data, Finance et le leadership France. Vous aurez un impact clé pour améliorer la performance des équipes, augmenter les revenus, maîtriser les dépenses et accroître la satisfaction.
Ce rôle est unique car il combine analyse de données, recommandations stratégiques, PMO et modélisation, tout en vous donnant une exposition directe au top management d’une des principales scale-ups tech européennes.

s.h: Vos responsabilités incluent mais ne sont pas limitées à
s.t:
1. Forecast & Business Planning
Travailler main dans la main avec Finance et le CC Performance Director pour construire, deux fois par an, des prévisions fiables de staffing et de performance à court, moyen et long terme.
2. Performance Monitoring
Développer et mettre en place des modèles de prévision afin d’améliorer la précision et la fiabilité de notre suivi de performance.
Piloter la performance CC en suivant de près les KPIs clés (Contact Ratio, Quality of Service…) au quotidien, chaque semaine et chaque mois.
Construire et maintenir des dashboards de performance CC pour les équipes opérationnelles et le leadership France.
Préparer les revues business mensuelles partagées avec le senior leadership (y compris les membres du Comex).
2. Analytics & Insights
Travailler avec les Data Product Managers et les Analytics Engineers pour garantir la qualité des données, des jeux de données fiables et des définitions de KPIs robustes pour les équipes Support.
Réaliser des analyses approfondies des métriques de performance Customer Care afin d’identifier tendances, insights et axes d’amélioration.
Transformer des jeux de données complexes en insights actionnables pour éclairer les décisions stratégiques et présenter des recommandations au senior leadership.
3. Gestion de projet / Stratégie
Collaborer avec les autres équipes Ops pour définir et déployer des stratégies et plans Support alignés sur les objectifs business de Doctolib.
Accompagner le déploiement de projets stratégiques (projets satisfaction, gestion des prestataires externes, etc.).
Les qualités attendues pour ce poste
Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

s.h: Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si
s.t:
Vous êtes à l’aise en français et en anglais.
Vous avez au moins 3 ans d’expérience en analytique (ops/business/stratégie, en entreprise ou en conseil).
Vous avez de solides compétences analytiques et en résolution de problèmes. Vous aimez à la fois imaginer de nouvelles solutions et entrer dans le détail de l’exécution et des opérations.
Vous manipulez des données au quotidien avec vos outils favoris (Excel, Google Sheets…) et maîtrisez des outils de data visualization comme Tableau, Power BI, Metabase ou équivalents.
Vous avez un fort sens business et de la communication : vous savez traduire des besoins métiers en exigences analytiques et communiquer clairement des insights à des parties prenantes non techniques.

s.h: Ce qui vous rendra successful dans ce rôle
s.t:
Drive & autonomie : vous portez vos projets avec un état d’esprit entrepreneurial.
Curiosité & learning agility : vous posez des questions, vous vous formez en autonomie sur de nouveaux outils et vous améliorez en continu.
Capacité à créer des relations : vous créez proactivement des liens avec des parties prenantes à travers l’organisation et vous générez de la confiance auprès de vos pairs.

We are looking for an Business Operations Manager with a structured mindset, who loves to improve efficiency in everything and help scale and optimize operations across Secret Media Network. This role will be fully focused on designing, implementing, and improving processes that drive efficiency, scalability, and performance across the organization.

Process Design & Optimization
Design, implement, and continuously improve operational workflows across SMN.
Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas of improvement, and translate them into scalable processes.
Standardize ways of working to ensure consistency and predictability in execution between different regions: North America, Europe, APAC, Latam
AI Automation & Tooling
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes using AI tools and internal systems.
Collaborate with Tech/Data teams to implement scalable solutions.
Leverage AI tools to improve productivity and execution speed.
Operational Excellence
Partner with stakeholders to ensure processes are adopted and correctly implemented.
Document and maintain clear operational playbooks.
Strategic Collaboration
Work closely with Marketing, Product, Data, and Local teams to align operations with business needs.
Act as a bridge between strategy and execution, ensuring operational feasibility.
Align the organization's business needs with technological and operational solutions by managing critical tools and procedures
Performance & Metrics
Define and track KPIs related to operational efficiency (e.g., post production time, output, quality).
Use data to identify improvement opportunities and drive decision-making.

You hold a Master’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Data Analytics (STEM degree)
5+ years of experience in strategy/operations consulting, supply chain, media operations, marketing operations, or production management — ideally in large-scale, fast-paced, digital-first organizations.
Strong experience in process design, optimization, and workflow automation.
Comfortable working with data and defining KPIs to measure performance.
Hands-on mindset: able to move from strategy to execution quickly.
Experience with automation tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Notion, Airtable, etc.) is a strong plus.
Familiarity with AI tools and interest in leveraging them for operational efficiency.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Proficiency in both written and spoken English is a must

We are seeking a highly motivated, organized, and adaptable individual to join our company as an Operations Support Specialist. You will play a crucial role within the global operations team, ensuring smooth workflows by managing vendor communications, purchase orders, and payment tracking.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams such as Procurement and Finance, gaining a comprehensive view of our global operations while providing essential administrative support that allows our strategic and analytical teams to focus on growth.

Global Operations Support: Act as the operational backbone of the team by managing essential daily workflows and ensuring our global pipeline runs seamlessly and efficiently.

Order & PO Tracking: Follow up on purchase orders and merchandising requests, ensuring constant alignment between external vendors and internal teams to keep deliveries on track.
Invoicing & Payments: Track vendor invoices and collaborate with the Finance team to guarantee on-time payments, proactively preventing any service blockages.
Prioritization & SLA Management: Analyze incoming requests and exercise good judgment to prioritize issues that pose a business risk, efficiently managing the backlog to meet strict SLAs.

We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?
To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
Ready to be part of the experience?
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Legal
As the legal team, we support all areas of Fever by offering scalable legal support – clear advice , risk management , and legal insight – that allow teams to move quickly and stay focused on what matters.
Our team is structured in:l Intellectual Property , Commercial, Strategic Transactions, Privacy, Dispute Resolution, and Legal Operations. Together, we cover the full legal landscape to meet the needs of a growing global business like Fever.
Join us if you are ready to tackle global challenges and provide strategic legal leadership to protect the long-term success of a rapidly growing tech leader.

We have an exciting opportunity for a candidate with a strong background in team leadership and knowledge management to join the Fever Legal GRC & Policy Team, here in Madrid, to manage our tech-enabled legal operations function.

We’re looking for applicants who are interested in shaping the future of Legal Operations at Fever, to remain cornerstone for sophisticated, value-driven and quick dealmaking at scale, and for effective and savvy risk management and seamless integration with company-wide tools and processes.
As a Legal Operations Manager, you will be a strategic leader responsible for driving the underpinning knowledge management for efficient, consistent, tech-scaled legal work, and championing operational excellence across the function aligning department-wide operations with broader business objectives.

This role sets the strategic priorities of our Legal Operations function, oversees the range of functions performed by the Legal Operations team, and involves the day-to-day management of team members.

s.h: In the first 60 days you will
s.t:
Meet the Legal Operations professionals who report directly or indirectly to the manager to establish working relationships and understand individual’s roles, strengths, and objectives
Understand current operational touchpoints, hand in hand with the Legal Operations team members and key stakeholders (including the Legal teams and Risk functions, as well as with relevant business functions)
Gain a thorough understanding of the existing legal technology stack, knowledge management systems, and current workflows, through both individual inquiry and participation in the existing initiatives and processes related to them
Build communication forums and practices with other individuals involved in designing, developing and/or in delivering operational solutions for the department, including AI Enablement, Business Operations, Privacy Operations, and beyond
Familiarize yourself with Fever’s global businesses and footprint, the legal landscape, corporate policies, and strategic business objectives
Review the current Legal function’s spending processes, and vendor relationships, creating systems to improve tracking, global law firm and related vendor (notarial, etc) management and billing practices

s.h: In the first 180 days you will
s.t:
Define objectives and KPIs for the Legal Operations team and establish a framework for tracking and reporting on operational metrics
Refine knowledge management structures and documentation standards to support efficient and consistent legal service delivery
Gain a thorough understanding of the existing workflows, knowledge and technology of the functions that legal and risk teams serve across the company, including Finance, Business Development, Media, Corporate Development and others
Become an active contributor to one or more ongoing initiatives in the implementation of tech-enabled processes across the department
Initiate a high-impact, quick-win project (e.g., streamlining a key administrative process or piloting a feature of an existing tech tool), building momentum and a practical understanding of change management
Become familiarized with the knowledge management, technology stack and current workflows of risk functions (Safety & Security, Insurance, etc)

Be a strategic leader of the Legal Operations function, evolving the strategic roadmap to drive sustained operational excellence at a global scale.
Oversee and enhance critical functional areas, including knowledge management, case support and documentation systems, and administrative functions within the team.
Evaluate, implement, and champion the adoption of emerging legal technologies, including AI and automation tools, to elevate the quality, speed, and scalability of the legal function.
Create and monitor department budgets, track spending, and identify cost-saving opportunities.
Manage a team of paralegals and legal operations staff, including empowering and mentoring coordinators within the team, conducting performance reviews, and driving their professional development.
Serve as a key liaison between the legal department and other business functions, acting with executive presence to influence stakeholders and ensuring alignment with company goals.

Have 3+ years of experience in innovation, knowledge management or tech implementation, including proven people management experience (bonus points for experience working with international teams and projects)..
Have prior experience as a lawyer, either in-house or in law firms, preferably through several legal fields, or can demonstrate a good understanding of the complexities related to the operational needs of disparate fields of legal work.
Are capable of learning through a self-motivated pursuit of the right questions, information and answers to acquire new skills as evolving environments require.
Demonstrate expertise in at least three of these areas: knowledge management, AI implementation, legal technology tools, process improvement, and operational management.
Have strong leadership and mentoring skills, strategic vision, and excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including cultural awareness, and empathy, along with the executive presence necessary to interact confidently with senior leadership.
Are professionally fluent in English (any other language can be a plus but is not required).

About Gusto
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

This is your chance to shape the foundation of a fast-growing, high-impact part of Gusto's business as a Senior Sales Operations Analyst supporting our Health Insurance (HI) Sales team. You'll build the insights and AI-powered solutions that make a large, high-volume sales organization, supporting 80+ reps across two segments.

You'll sit at the intersection of data, process, and execution; you'll turn real sales challenges into the tools, reports, automations, and workflows that move the numbers.
You'll help grow a business segment that serves tens of thousands of small businesses through smarter, data-driven sales strategies. If you thrive where analytics, problem-solving, and supporting others meet, this role offers ownership, visibility, and the chance to influence how Gusto sells health insurance.

The HI Sales Operations team partners closely with sales leadership to support two dynamic, fast-moving sales teams that contribute meaningfully to Gusto's growth. We think of ourselves as builders, problem solvers, and strategic partners; we turn uncertainty into clarity and fragmented processes into scalable, repeatable systems.
Our work spans quotas, pipeline health, forecasting, process design, data integrity, account and territory administration, go-to-market strategy, and increasingly, AI-driven optimization. We value curiosity, open communication, and a commitment to helping 80+ sales reps operate efficiently and confidently.

Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting
Build, automate, and maintain reports and dashboards that track sales performance, funnel metrics, pipeline health, SLAs, and rep productivity; keep definitions consistent and documentation clear.
Partner with RevOps, Finance, Marketing, and Analytics to produce operational reporting, revenue insights, and forecasting models across the weekly forecast, monthly reviews, and QBR cadence.
Own metric definitions and data accuracy so leaders trust the numbers they act on.
Drive AI Strategy for Sales
Identify and prototype AI and automation tools, such as content generation, analytics copilots, and call coaching, that remove manual friction from the sales process.
Partner with Sales, BizTech, Product, and Enablement to embed AI into daily sales workflows, improving both efficiency and effectiveness.
Source and lead net-new AI and automation projects, connecting data insights to process improvements that lift rep productivity.
Process Design & Continuous Improvement
Examine workflows and rep performance to identify bottlenecks; recommend and implement process and automation changes that improve conversion, efficiency, and the rep experience.
Partner with Sales Enablement to document processes, build playbooks, and drive adoption of new tools and workflows.
Operational Support & Problem-Solving
Provide day-to-day support to HI Sales leadership and reps: ad hoc data requests, process issues, and one-off investigations.
Own account and territory administration as the business evolves, assignment and coverage upkeep, book reassignments for leave and departures, large-scale account rerouting, and segment reclassification, supported by lead-routing and round-robin automation.
Support territory, quota, and coverage planning, plus monthly sales-compensation reconciliation.
Troubleshoot reporting issues, broken workflows, missing CRM data, and gaps in pipeline visibility with fast, accurate fixes.
Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication
Work closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Finance, BizTech, and Product to keep everyone aligned and remove obstacles to progress.
Translate sales challenges into clear business requirements; partner cross-functionally to design solutions and durable improvements.
Keep stakeholders aligned with clear, regular updates to managers and senior leadership on timelines, risks, and outcomes.
Act as a trusted advisor, bringing structure, insight, and clarity to complex or ambiguous problems.

5+ years in Sales Ops, RevOps, or a similar analytical GTM role; ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or fintech environment.
Strong Salesforce proficiency; you can spot data issues, audit pipeline problems, manage account ownership and routing, and build reports and dashboards that reps and leaders actually use.
Analytical depth across Salesforce reports and dashboards, SQL, Tableau or Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets.
Hands-on experience with forecasting, pipeline management, and territory or quota planning on a recurring cadence; for example, a weekly forecast feeding monthly reviews and QBRs.
Comfort evaluating AI and automation tools and prototyping simple workflows to improve productivity.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you simplify complex information and create alignment from frontline reps to senior directors.
A first-principles problem solver who breaks down ambiguous issues, tests hypotheses, and builds structured solutions.
Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, you manage multiple projects and recurring workflows while protecting data quality and operational reliability.
A strong partner to sales, with a track record supporting teams that have competing, fast-changing priorities.

Experience in payroll, HR tech, or SMB SaaS go-to-market motions.
Experience supporting a regulated or compliance-driven sales segment such as health insurance or benefits.
Experience designing or implementing automations, AI workflows, or similar tooling.
A track record of building cross-functional relationships across Sales, BizTech, and Analytics.
Experience building systems to support new or evolving sales motions, with comfort in fast iteration and testing in live sales environments.

Storyblok is hiring a Deal Operations Manager to build the operating workflow for how deals are structured, reviewed, approved, executed, and handed off across quote-to-cash.

The role supports Sales on deal construction and deal design strategy, coordinates Legal execution, partners with Finance on revenue recognition readiness, and turns pricing, packaging, and NPI decisions into field-ready operating process.

Sitting within Revenue Operations, this role works across Sales, Sales Leadership, Finance, Legal, Deal Strategy, Systems, Order Management, Security, Customer Success, and Product / Packaging to make approval-ready deals faster and downstream defects lower.

Deal operations workflow and process
Build the global deal operations workflow for intake, routing, approval readiness, SLAs, escalation paths, and exception handling.
Own approval readiness in DealHub CPQ, including required fields, quote quality checks, approval context, discount rationale, and downstream handoff inputs.
Maintain practical process documentation, templates, and decision rules so Sales can move standard deals through documented paths.
Deal construction and design strategy support
Support Sales and Sales Leadership on deal construction across new business, renewal, expansion, multi-year, ramped, multi-product, and non-standard commercial requests.
Translate deal strategy into approval-ready constructs with clear value exchange, risk flags, concession logic, billing terms, contract timing, and implementation assumptions.
Partner with Deal Strategy, Customer Success, Product / Packaging, and Finance when commercial design affects retention, expansion, product adoption, or reporting.
Legal execution and Finance revenue recognition readiness
Engage Legal early on non-standard terms, contract language, execution path, risk ownership, and customer-requested changes.
Coordinate with Finance on revenue recognition inputs, billing terms, payment terms, start dates, product lines, order form clarity, and required approval evidence.
Maintain pre-signature checks for deals with rev rec, billing, custom terms, or product readiness risk.
Pricing, packaging, NPI, and DealHub CPQ rollout
Participate in pricing and packaging execution and strategy support so decisions can be turned into field process, DealHub CPQ logic, approval paths, and reporting readiness.
Support NPI rollout by defining deal rules, quote requirements, launch constraints, fallback paths, and field guidance for early transactions.
Track whether pricing, packaging, or NPI changes create quote exceptions, approval confusion, billing defects, or customer handoff issues.
Quote-to-cash quality, cadence, and continuous improvement
Own the operating handoff from approved quote to order, billing, commissions, reporting, and customer lifecycle records.
Run the deal operations cadence with KPI packs, defect logs, root-cause reviews, action owners, and process improvements.
Identify automation and AI use cases tied to intake, routing, approval summaries, quote checks, documentation, and measurable cycle-time reduction.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years in Deal Desk, Deal Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a comparable commercial operations role, ideally in B2B SaaS.
Hands-on experience with CPQ tooling (DealHub or comparable) and quote-to-cash / lead-to-cash processes.
Demonstrated experience structuring and reviewing non-standard deals (multi-year, ramped, expansion, multi-product) and partnering with Sales on deal construction.
Working knowledge of revenue recognition concepts, billing and order processes, and coordinating contract execution with Legal and Finance.
Experience building scalable process, documentation, SLAs, and operating cadences (KPI reviews, defect logs, root-cause analysis).
Strong analytical skills and comfort working in Salesforce and reporting tools.
Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

Commercial acumen: structures sound deals that balance customer value, risk, and revenue / margin outcomes.
Process design: builds clear, scalable workflows, SLAs, and escalation paths that scale beyond manual effort.
Cross-functional coordination: aligns Sales, Legal, Finance, Systems, Order Management, and CS around complete deal packages.
Attention to detail: enforces quote quality, approval readiness, and pre-signature checks to reduce downstream defects.
Operating rigor: runs cadences with KPIs, defect logs, and root-cause reviews that drive measurable improvement.
Influence without authority: guides Sales toward documented paths and sound commercial discipline.
Communication: produces clear guidance, decision rules, and leadership-ready operating views.
Continuous improvement and automation mindset: identifies automation / AI use cases that reduce cycle time and rework.
Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

We’re looking for a motivated, hands-on Fleet Ops Manager to lead our fleet operations on the ground in South America. When we say Fleet, we mean the hardware - collars and towers that are what makes us Halter. This is a rare opportunity to build something genuinely new, leading a team and getting Halter up and running in a region with enormous potential for cattle producers.
You’ll own the operational system for the region from the ground up. That means leading and developing a team of Fleet Ops Specialists, owning the maintenance system, and making sure our hardware infrastructure runs without a hitch. You’ll be the first point of escalation when things get tricky in the field, and the person who makes sure the right people are in the right place at the right time.
South America is a critical and exciting market for us. You’ll help us understand the unique nuances of cattle production in the region and feed those learnings back to our product and engineering teams in Auckland. What you and your team learn in the field will directly shape what we build next.
You’ll work closely with dedicated teams in South America, the United States, and at Halter’s Auckland HQ. You’ll play a key role in making sure our pioneering producers in the region get an unmatched experience from day one.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Lead and develop your team: Lead, coordinate, and support a team of Fleet Ops Specialists across day-to-day operations. Support their growth, give great feedback, and help them focus on what matters.
Performance management: Own performance management for your team. Set clear expectations, hold people accountable, and help everyone do their best work.
Planning and scheduling: Plan and schedule team workloads to make sure the right people are in the right place at the right time across the region.
Recruitment: Lead recruitment activities to keep the team resourced and all roles filled across South America.
First point of escalation: Be the go-to person when things get tricky in the field. Help your team find solutions quickly and keep operations moving.
Own the maintenance system: Build out, improve, and own the maintenance system for the South American market. Make sure the team runs it consistently.
Hands-on when it counts: Get hands-on with maintenance, hardware upkeep, and repairs when needed. You’re a player-coach, not just a manager.
Hardware diagnosis: Diagnose hardware issues in the field and feed findings back to the relevant internal teams quickly.
Deployment support: Provide on-site and remote support during farm deployments including drone mapping, installs, go-live, and collaring. Own the scheduling and execution of collaring activities on new and existing farms.
On-call: Support the global on-call roster for hardware-related incidents and make sure your team is well set up to do the same.
Data and insights: Collect, interpret, and analyse data from our hardware to optimise processes, resolve issues proactively, and inform decision-making. Track team output and surface insights to improve how the team works.
Field insights: Feed learnings back clearly to our product and engineering teams, so we’re always building what matters most for South American cattle producers.
Collaboration: Work closely across Halter’s teams to stay aligned and drive strong customer outcomes.
Travel: With producers and your team spread across South America, you’ll be on the road regularly. Expect 3 to 4 days a week and some nights away from home.
Whatever else it takes: This is an early-stage market entry. You’ll do what needs doing to make Halter succeed in South America.

Proven leadership experience: You’ve led field or operations teams before. You know how to build a high-performing team, manage performance, and develop people.
Hands-on experience: Practical experience with tools, electrical work, construction, networking, or equipment fitting is a must. You’re comfortable getting your hands dirty alongside your team.
South American cattle production experience: You know the land, the animals, and the way producers in this region operate. This is a must-have.
Go-getter attitude: You’re proactive, you take ownership, and you’re not afraid to figure things out on the go.
Strong communicator: You can translate what you’re seeing in the field into clear, actionable feedback for a remote product and engineering team. You set clear direction for your team and keep everyone aligned.
Organised and structured: You manage workloads, scheduling, and competing priorities across a team without dropping the ball.
Comfortable with ambiguity: This is early-stage market entry. Things will be imperfect. You’ll thrive on that rather than be frustrated by it.
Commitment to excellence: You take pride in delivering the best possible service and hold your team to the same standard.
Willingness to travel: You’re up for regular and sometimes spontaneous travel across the region.
Language: Spanish + English fluency is required.

Broader agriculture or agri-tech experience beyond cattle production.
Experience scaling a team in an early-stage or high-growth environment.

Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good.
Merchandising Operations Manager
Grove's merchandising operation is full of good instincts running on manual work. This role exists to fix that: redesign the core processes, then personally build the automation that makes them stick. This is a rare shot at rebuilding how merchandising actually runs, and at proving AI belongs in the hands of the person closest to the problem, not just the AI team.
We're not hiring someone to write a strategy memo about AI and hand it off. We're hiring someone who will map the workflow, feel where it breaks, and then sit down and build the thing that fixes it.
More About the Opportunity
Merchandising at Grove runs on real expertise and too much manual glue.
Buyers chase vendors for the same data, week after week.
Marketing launches promotions inventory finds out about too late.
Good people spend their time on work a workflow should be doing for them.
We have an internal AI team. They coach. They don't build for you.
This role is for the person who wants their hands on the keyboard, not the person who scopes it and waits.
The honest version: no template here. You're defining the standard as you go, with review at key milestones and real autonomy in between.
Some of what you build will work on the first try. Some won't. That's the job.
What You'll Own
Map how merchandising actually works today, not how the org chart says it works.
Redesign core operating processes for speed, accuracy, and margin protection: assortment planning, item setup, pricing and markdown, vendor and PO management, allocation, replenishment.
Own the calendar connecting marketing activations to inventory, so launches are stock-backed, not a surprise to the warehouse.
Translate activation plans into buy, allocation, and replenishment signals; flag stock risk before launch, not after.
Coordinate vendor commitments tied to activations: fill rates, lead times, launch quantities.
Build self-service tools and proactive alerts that scale the buyer-vendor relationship, including visibility into vendor performance.
Build the automation yourself, using Claude and comparable AI tools, no/low-code platforms, and lightweight automation, from concept through rollout.
Run pilots end to end: scope, build, test for accuracy, validate fit, scale. Keep humans in the loop on margin- and inventory-critical decisions.
Maintain a registry of approved tools and active automations, so what exists and what it's for is never a mystery.
Own change management for every rollout: training, AI literacy for non-technical audiences, office hours, a bench of power users.
Build reporting on process and automation performance, and use it to prioritize what gets built next.

Real fluency in retail merchandising operations, not an adjacent function you've watched from a distance.
You've mapped a broken process and redesigned it, not just diagnosed it.
Basic technical acumen and a genuine willingness to build, no engineering background required.
Comfortable working with a specialist team as a coaching resource, not a build team, and taking their guidance without handing off your job.
You've run a pilot from scoping through adoption, and you know the gap between a demo and something people actually use.
You care about the boring, durable stuff: documentation, SOPs, registries, training, the things that outlast the person who built them.
You think in workflows and root causes, not tickets.
You know the difference between a problem worth automating and one worth leaving alone.
Even Better if You Have
Built something with Claude or a comparable AI tool that a non-technical team now relies on.
Experience connecting marketing or demand planning to inventory and allocation.
Designed a self-service tool that measurably cut manual buyer-vendor back-and-forth.
A retail, CPG, or commerce background with real fluency in vendor and marketplace dynamics.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

We are looking for an experienced General Manager who has successfully built and led sales and technical teams. The GM will be responsible for the overall UK strategy and deliverables, in line with company priorities. We are looking for an execution-focused operator who can propel ElevenLabs in the market.

Develop and execute our UK country strategy, including sales, customer delivery, KPI setting and hiring
Design the optimal pipeline to reach our ambitious sales targets on the B2B side. In this sense, you will be expected to lead interactions with the top 30 strategic accounts in the market
Hire the founding country team responsible for sales and implementations
Define event priorities and where to invest for brand awareness
Represent ElevenLabs in events and media appearances
Work with the partner ecosystem to generate new collaborations and sales opportunities, in partnership with the global BD team
Ideate, own and drive big bets in the UK

15+ years of experience leading teams and highly complex projects
Background in consulting and sales
Deep expertise in deploying technical products and/or solutions to enterprises
Owner mentality. Hands-on and self-starter who is keen to get their hands dirty to produce results
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills
A hands-on leader who thinks outside the box and wants to generate results
Proven ability to build and scale high-performing teams
Established professional network across the UK enterprise and B2B landscape

Process Overview Global Markets Global Valuation Group (GVG) is a division of Global Banking & Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for providing valuation and independent price verification methodology support to Business Finance & Control (BFC) teams for execution of IPV, calculation of valuation adjustments and prudential valuation adjustments.

The team is also responsible for reporting and governance across all valuation processes. Additionally, the team works on a number of regulatory deliverables related to valuations and drives the overall valuation control automation agenda in partnership with Technology and other stakeholders.

The team works closely with front office, middle office, traders, business finance controllers, market risk, quantitative risk and technology teams to drive the control agenda across the business.

Job Description We are looking to hire a seasoned leader in the Global Valuations Group to project manage number of regulatory deliverables for GM & GCIB Finance organization. The person will be responsible for planning of regulatory engagement through the cycle from early notification to remediation phases.

They will be required to manage stakeholders from different divisions within the bank to ensure that right responsibilities are allocated to right teams and the teams deliver on those in a timely fashion.

They will be helping the team put together regulatory submissions, will track progress and milestones, escalate risks as needed and facilitate issue resolution.

Given this role will be part of the valuations group and will involve interactions with senior management of technical functions, we need the person to have a deep understanding of all regulatory guidelines (like CCAR stress testing, Prudential Valuation guidelines from a PRA and ECB perspective, ICAAP etc.).

Additionally, they should also have a good knowledge of financial products and their valuations. Ideally, this role will best suit a person who has already been managing such technical regulatory projects for multiple years.

Responsibilities Planning of regulatory engagement through the cycle from early notification to remediation phases Stakeholder management including ensuring adequate ownership and responsibilities of the different parties involved End to end project management of regulatory deliverables including putting together submissions, tracking of progress and milestone, escalation of risks and issues and facilitating issue resolution Providing upward communication on project progress to CFO senior leadership Ensuring high quality outputs from SME team by setting standards and providing guidance on expectations Interpret regulatory changes and engage with CFO teams to perform impact assessments and drive change so that we are compliant with the new changes Put together technical presentations in partnership with CFO teams Drive the operational excellence agenda, ensuring process standardization, controls maturity, and continuous improvement across business-critical activities.

Drive valuation related projects such as market data assessment for various asset classes, back-testing of results as per regulatory guidelines, drive intra-month prices testing of results etc.

Manage the overall Model governance process for valuation related models Identify, document, and assess AI opportunities; collaborate with Technology, FLUs, and SMEs to evaluate feasibility, ROI, risk considerations, and operational impact.

Ensure adherence to AI use-case governance, including risk alignment, model-development documentation, compliance with enterprise AI policies, and responsible-AI practices. Govern technology and change portfolios, ensuring transparency, prioritization, sequencing, and delivery accountability.

Requirements Education Graduate/ Postgraduate in Finance/Management from Tier I/II institute Experience Range 12-18 years of relevant experience in finance domain related to project management of quantitative/technical regulatory projects or Valuations / Valuation Governance Foundational skills Good understanding of regulatory landscape (Prudential valuation guidelines, ICAAP, CCAR, Valuation principles) Ability to interpret regulatory guidelines (existing and forthcoming) and identify gaps/perform impact assessments Strong project management skills with prior experience of running end to end project management for regulatory engagements ideally for large banks Strong organization and structured thinking Strong communication skills to be able to present to a highly technical and senior audience Strong written communication skills and dashboarding skills Good knowledge of global markets products along with basic risk and valuation principles Attention to details and rigor to meet expectations or internal audit and supervisor requirements.

Ability to work under tight deadlines Strong technology skills (understanding of automation tools such as Alteryx) and understanding of AI tools to enable identification and implementation of OPEX opportunities Experience working with Technology partners on architecture discussions, feasibility assessments, and solution design Additional skills Prior experience leading engagement with model governance and awareness of model governance life cycle Hands on experience with coding (ex: Python) Hands on experience in managing AI projects at large scale Strong understanding of Market risk and valuation principles.

Prior experience performing market data assessment and working with vendors on assessing quality of data Work Timings 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST Job Location* Mumbai/Gurgaon

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

We are looking for a passionate and results-driven General Manager - UAE who will be responsible for developing and executing the overall strategy for the UAE. As a key member of the leadership team, you will own the UAE strategy & execution, build a world-class culture, and ensure our Middle East business aligns with and contributes to our overall business strategy and goals.

· Revenue Growth Strategy & Targets : Develop and execute a comprehensive revenue growth strategy to meet the company’s goals in the UAE market.

Our Frontline Perception System (FPS) helps military and national security operators detect threats, accelerate decision-making, and unlock the power of AI at the tactical edge. We endeavor to build mission-valuable products in command and control, autonomy, and AI-enabled mission systems.

We partner directly with frontline users to deliver mission-ready capabilities that work in real-world environments where speed, trust, reliability, and operational resilience matter most. Field Engagement Operations: Own the end-to-end operational workflow for Field Engineering from resourcing and readiness to execution and closeout. Maintain the field engagement tracker, validate upcoming requests, and drive pre-deployment planning discipline.

Field Hardware: Own the operational readiness of field hardware. Coordinate imaging, configuration, software versioning, testing, and shipping for deployments and demos. Maintain standard loadouts and coordinate with Engineering/IT/DevOps.

Field Asset Management: Create and maintain the asset-management system. Track inventory, custody, location, status, and lifecycle management for all field gear.

Field Knowledge Management: Own the field knowledge base. Maintain SOPs, checklists, templates, and AARs. Ensure lessons learned are captured and reusable.

Field Communications: Own communication rhythms. Translate product updates into field-relevant guidance, coordinate daily SITREPs, and provide operational updates to leadership.

Field Enablement: Own the Field Engineering readiness model. Build onboarding pathways, define readiness requirements, and run enablement sessions and assessments to ensure FEs are prepared for mission types and hardware loadouts.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to create clear documentation and standardized operating procedures.

About GENUINE
GENUINE is at the forefront of the social commerce revolution. As a fast-growing TikTok Shop Agency, we don’t just create content—we build high-converting shopping experiences. We operate at the intersection of entertainment and commerce, moving at the speed of a viral trend.
To fuel our next stage of growth, we are looking for a data-driven Finance & Operations Manager who thrives in a high-speed environment.
The Mission
You will be the architect of our financial engine. Your goal is to ensure that as our GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) is strongly growing, our margins remain healthy and our cash flow stays liquid.
You will bridge the gap between TikTok’s backend data, our payouts, and our internal profitability.
Aufgaben

Revenue & Commission Reconciliation: Manage the complex flow of funds from TikTok Shop, including platform fees, affiliate payouts, and client disbursements.
Performance Controlling: Analyze the ROI of creator campaigns and live-stream sessions.
You tell us which creators are profitable and which aren't. Cash Flow & Payout Management: Ensure creators and partners are paid accurately and on time while optimizing our own working capital.
Process Automation: You will help implement and oversee tools that connect TikTok Shop data with our accounting software
Commercial Strategy: Support the leadership team in pricing our services—moving from pure retainers to performance-based models (revenue share).
Qualifikation
Your Profile
Experience: 2-4 years in Finance, Controlling, or Ops. Experience in E-commerce, D2C brands, or Affiliate Marketing is a massive plus.
Data Literacy: You are a Google Sheets/Excel wizard. You don't just see numbers; you see patterns and "leaks" in the funnel.
Agility: You thrive in "organized chaos." A TikTok algorithm change doesn't scare you; you adapt the reporting by EOD.
Tech Savvy: Familiarity with e-commerce backends (Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center) and modern fintech tools (Spendesk, Moss, etc.).

What’s In It For You
Front-Row Seats to the Future: Join the #1 TikTok Shop partner in Germany. You won’t just be watching social commerce grow; you’ll be the one building it across Europe for the world’s most iconic brands.
A "Day One" Culture: We move fast. Enjoy an international, high-vibe team environment where your ideas don't get stuck in meetings—they get executed.
Direct Impact, Zero Red Tape: Work in a flat hierarchy where you collaborate directly with seasoned experts and have the autonomy to own your projects.
The Cologne Lifestyle: Our modern HQ is located right in the heart of Cologne, surrounded by the city's best energy (and coffee).
Serious Growth: Whether it’s client management, creative production, or deep-dive e-commerce, you’ll be gaining a toolkit that is currently the most in-demand in the global marketing industry.
Team Spirit: We work hard, but we celebrate even harder with regular team events and an appreciative, open atmosphere.
We are the largest TikTok Shop partner in Europe, and we are looking for someone to help us bridge the gap between creative production and modern e-commerce. If you’re ready to lead the social commerce revolution in Europe, we’re ready for you.

GENUINE is one of Germany's leading TikTok Shop partners with offices in Shanghai, Cologne, Hong Kong, and Berlin. Our team brings more than nine years of experience from the social commerce market in China and Southeast Asia. GENUINE was founded in 2017 by Damian Maib in Shanghai.

There, we helped German brands gain a successful foothold in China and position their products in front of millions of consumers. Since 2025, we have also been active in Europe, assisting leading companies in setting up their TikTok Shops.

Regional General Manager, Airports
As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region.

Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.
This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.
The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.
Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.
Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.
Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives.

Business leadership experience with a significant level of internal and external dependencies and relationships.
Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget.

Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels.

Es ist Zeit für die Praxis der Zukunft, werde Teil von PraxisEins!
PraxisEins ist ein Healthcare Scale-up aus Frankfurt : Wir bauen Deutschlands führenden Primärversorger auf. So sichern wir langfristig die hausärztliche Versorgung in Deutschland , insbesondere in schlecht versorgten Gebieten.
Unsere erfahrenen Kollegen kommen von führenden Unternehmen wie BCG, McKinsey, Goldman Sachs und Oaktree Capital und haben bereits erfolgreich Unternehmen auf- und ausgebaut. Seit Gründung 2022 konnten wir so bereits auf >350 Mitarbeiter:innen wachsen. Werde auch Du Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte!
Du kommst aus einem hochkompetitiven Umfeld , zum Beispiel aus der Strategieberatung, und willst raus aus der reinen Analyse und rein in echte unternehmerische Verantwortung , wo Du wirklich etwas bewegen kannst? Dich begeistert ein Mix aus strategischem Gestaltungsspielraum und operativ-kommerzieller Optimierung und Du willst Deine wirtschaftliche Expertise bei einem dynamisch wachsenden Scale-up in der Primärversorgung unter Beweis stellen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.
Die Rolle berichtet direkt an die regionale Geschäftsführung und wird in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Ärztlichen Leitungen und medizinischen Teams unserer Zentren arbeiten.
In dieser Rolle wirst Du
Unsere Standorte kaufmännisch leiten: Du übernimmst die P&L-Verantwortung für mehrere Standorte und stellst die Einhaltung der PraxisEins-Qualitätsstandards in unseren Einrichtungen sicher.
Teams führen: Du bist in der Lage Menschen mitzunehmen und durch positives Vorangehen zu führen. Es ist Dir ein wesentliches Anliegen, für Deine Mitarbeiter und Teams ein gutes Arbeitsumfeld zu gewährleisten, das Leistung durch effektive Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit fördert.

Wachstum durch Standortentwicklung vorantreiben: Du erkennst organische und anorganische Wachstumschancen in Deiner Region frühzeitig und setzt diese um.
Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit
Erstklassigen Ärztinnen und Ärzten in den Bereichen der Allgemeinmedizin, Inneren Medizin, Schmerztherapie und Neurologie.
Einem erfahrenen Managementteam mit Hintergrund u.a. bei BCG, McKinsey, Oaktree, Goldman Sachs.
Unserem Product und Engineering Team mit dem Du gemeinsam die Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelösungen vorantreibst.

Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld, z. B. in der Strategieberatung (McKinsey, BCG o.Ä.), im Banking, in Private Equity oder in ähnlich schnelllebigen Unternehmen.

Unternehmerisches Denken mit der Fähigkeit, große Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Problemlösungen unabhängig voranzutreiben.

Karriereboost: Bei uns arbeitest Du mit einem erstklassigen Team, so entwickelst Du Dich führungstechnisch und unternehmerisch schnell weiter.

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.
As we scale following our Series B, we are looking for a Senior Fund Operations Manager to play a key role in delivering exceptional fund operations and service quality to our customers. This is not a traditional fund administration role focused on repetitive processing.
We are looking for operators who deeply understand private markets operations, enjoy solving complexity, and want to help shape how modern fund administration should work.
You will work at the intersection of fund operations, client service, and product development - partnering closely with fund managers, investors, product teams, and internal operations functions to deliver a seamless experience across the full fund lifecycle.
We are particularly looking for strong expertise in fund administration, transfer agency operations, fund onboarding, and complex post-close operational processes.

Act as a strategic operational partner to fund managers, supporting them across the day-to-day operations of their funds and delivering an exceptional customer experience.
Own and coordinate complex post-close operational processes, including capital calls, distributions, investor reporting cycles, and ongoing fund lifecycle events.
Lead operational execution for fund migrations and new fund launches, including the review, reconciliation, and migration of historical data from previous administrators.
Own capital call and distribution calculations end-to-end using our automated operational workflows, including the interpretation of LPA clauses, management fee calculations, equalisation mechanics, liquidity buffer assessments, and investor allocation logic.
Partner directly with fund managers to explain methodologies, align on assumptions and outputs, incorporate feedback where appropriate, and guide clients towards operationally and legally sound approaches based on fund documentation.
Partner with Fund Accounting to support recurring reporting cycles and ensure operational and financial data is complete, accurate, and audit-ready.
Support treasury-related workflows, including payment coordination, invoice handling, and operational cash movement processes.
Act as a key point of contact for fund managers and investors, helping resolve operational queries with a high level of responsiveness and ownership.
Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to shape and improve our internal platform and operational tooling based on real customer workflows and operational pain points.
Help drive the evolution of our “full back-office” operating model by identifying opportunities for automation, AI adoption, and scalable operational design.
Support, review, and mentor more junior team members, helping establish high standards for quality, operational rigour, and client service.
Improve processes, workflows, and documentation across the organisation to increase scalability, transparency, and operational excellence.

You bring 3+ years of experience in fund administration, fund operations, transfer agency, or related private markets operations environments.
You have strong hands-on experience managing operational fund workflows across the full lifecycle, particularly capital activity, reporting processes, and complex operational coordination.
You understand private markets fund structures and are comfortable reviewing LPAs, investment agreements, and related fund documentation to identify operationally relevant terms and requirements.
You are highly detail-oriented and able to manage complex operational processes with accuracy and ownership under tight timelines.
You are comfortable working cross-functionally with other Fund Accounting, Product, and client-facing teams.
You bring a strong service mindset and understand how operational quality directly impacts customer trust and long-term relationships.
You enjoy improving systems and processes and are excited by the opportunity to help modernise fund administration through technology and AI.
You are proactive, structured, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
You enjoy mentoring others and raising the operational quality bar across a team.
You are fluent in English; German is a plus.

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.
Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.
Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.
Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

Spot inefficiencies and suggest practical improvements that align with business priorities.
Use tools and systems to simplify people processes and make them more scalable.
Work closely with teams across the business to drive projects from start to finish.
Maintain clear SOPs and policies so people processes are consistent across locations.
Resolve day-to-day people queries around people topics
Partner effectively with external providers (payroll, benefits, etc.) to ensure smooth and reliable service delivery.
Track compliance and manage risks across the regions you support.

Advanced knowledge of HRIS systems, particularly HiBob
Ability to handle complex projects, strong analytical skills, and attention to detail

Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market.

Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent stakeholder communication, including executive level.
Strong project and cross-functional coordination skills.

Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Du optimierst und standardisierst Ops-Prozesse entlang der Supply Chain mit Fokus auf Logistik, Materialplanung, Einkauf und Warehousing .
Du identifizierst Ineffizienzen , führst Root-Cause-Analysen durch und setzt messbare Verbesserungen um (z. B. Lead Times, Bestände, Lieferperformance, Fehlteile).
Du baust Analysen, Dashboards und Reporting für die operative Steuerung (E2E-Transparenz, Bottlenecks, SLA- und Ticket-Tracking).
Du definierst und steuerst zentrale KPIs (z. B. OTIF, Inventory Accuracy, Stock Turns, Backlog, Ticket Aging) inkl. Interpretation und Maßnahmenableitung.
Du treibst End-to-End Projekte : Scope/Business Case, Priorisierung, Umsetzung, Rollout, Adoption und nachhaltige Verankerung (SOPs, Trainings).
Du managst Stakeholder cross-funktional in Operations sowie an den Schnittstellen zu Product (u. a. Leads Product) und Tech (Daten, Automatisierung, Tooling).
Du lieferst klare Recommendations und Updates im direkten Reporting an die Managing Directors (Reviews, Entscheidungen, Maßnahmen-Tracking).
Dein Profil
2 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in Operations / Supply Chain , Prozessoptimierung, Analytics oder einem vergleichbaren, datengetriebenen Umfeld.
Background aus High-Performance-Umfeldern (Start-up/Scale-up, Unternehmensberatung , PE/VC , Venture Building) ist starkes Plus.
Du kombinierst Analytical Excellence mit Ownership : du arbeitest strukturiert, entscheidungsorientiert und bringst Themen konsequent ins Ziel.
Du bist stark im Stakeholdermanagement (Alignment, Entscheidungsfindung, Konfliktlösung, klare Kommunikation).
Du hast Erfahrung in KPI-Setup und Reporting/Dashboards (z. B. Data aggregation in Snowflake/AirTable + Data visualization in Tableau/PowerBI).
Du kannst Anforderungen sauber zwischen Ops, Product und Tech übersetzen.
Deutsch und Englisch fließend.

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

In this key role, you act as the operational backbone of our Munich office, driving efficiency, structure, and seamless daily execution. You will take full ownership of our workplace environment, fleet operations, vendor management, and internal administrative workflows as we continue to scale rapidly. Your proactive, hands-on approach directly ensures our team has the support and infrastructure needed to build the future of industrial robotics.

Drive Office Organization & Front Desk Management: Serve as the central point of contact for daily office operations, managing phone and mail communications, maintaining a representative environment, and coordinating cleaning teams and facility maintenance.
Automate & Lead Fleet Management: Oversee our entire vehicle fleet by managing leasing companies, vehicle acquisitions, and maintenance, while driving process automation using modern tools.
Manage Travel & Company Events: Plan and organize business trips, hotel bookings, and appointment scheduling, alongside organizing internal team gatherings, in-office events, and company-wide celebrations.
Office & Documentation Support: Serve as the on-site point of contact for invoice and documentation collection, checking cost centers, uploading physical invoices in our expense management system, plus occasional in-person support for signatures and NDAs.
Ensure Workplace Safety: Act as the designated safety officer, ensuring all health and safety regulations are strictly adhered to, monitored, and continuously optimized.
Coordinate External Vendors & Tradespeople: Actively manage third-party office service providers, building managers, and external suppliers to maintain smooth site operations.
Automate Operational Processes: Continuously evaluate internal administrative workflows, digitizing and streamlining manual tasks leveraging tools like Notion, Claude and Google Workspace.

s.h: We're looking for someone who has
s.t:
Completed vocational training or a degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Facility Management, Hospitality or comparable experience.
Several years of experience in Office Management or Workplace Operations.
Strong track record in process automation and documentation tools to digitize operations like fleet management.
High proficiency with tools like Notion, Moss, and Google Workspace.
Willingness to work onsite at our Munich office 4-5 days (up to) a week (with up to 1 Home Office day per week).
Culture-aligned mindset (e.g., "Strong ownership mindset", "Hands-on mindset", "Pragmatic working style").
Very good English skills and fluent German language skills (written and spoken) are required.

Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.
Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.
As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.
Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.
Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously
Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.
Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.
About RobCo
Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.
We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics.

With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Verantwortung und Durchführung von Übertragungen, Zulagenmanagement, Bonusanträgen sowie der steuerlichen Abwicklung und dem Edge-Case-Handling unter strikter Einhaltung von SLAs und KPIs.
